CLASSIFICATION COMPLETE -- all eight previously-unclassified sites resolved. See coordination post.

CLEARED as correct (similarity measures where 0.0 honestly means 'no similarity'): StorySourceView.scala:236, induce.scala:203, induce.scala:335, SoftCompatibility.scala:47. Do not touch.

CONFIRMED and all PUBLISHED SIGNATURE FIELDS -- start here, they are ADR 0003 estimands: signature.scala:264 uniform -> uniformCoverage (serialised :594); :463 extMean -> published per ExternalState (:481-484); :464 distorted -> published (:471). signature.scala:466 byFacet is MITIGATED by .filter(_._2 > 0.0), which drops zeros so empty rows give an empty map.

uniformCoverage reports 0.0 coverage with no leaves to cover -- same shape as Coverage.fraction. distorted reports 0.0 distortion for a recall that produced no rows at all, which reads as undistorted.

CAUTION recorded on the board: the tempting rule 'similarity measures got it right, distance measures got it wrong' holds for six sites and FAILS on frameOverlap (SoftCompatibility:43), a similarity returning 1.0 on empty. The defects cluster where the flattering value is also the obvious default, not where the natural zero is.
